parts.label: (a)
parts.text:
Complete the following electronic structures.

- the iron atom, $\text{Fe}$ $1\text{s}^22\text{s}^22\text{p}^6$

- the iron(III) ion, $\text{Fe}^{3+}$ $1\text{s}^22\text{s}^22\text{p}^6$

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Solutions of iron(III) salts are acidic due to the equilibrium shown.

$$[\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{3+}(\text{aq}) \rightleftharpoons [\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_5(\text{OH})]^{2+}(\text{aq}) + \text{H}^+(\text{aq}) \quad K_{\text{a}} = 8.9 \times 10^{-4}\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$$

Calculate the pH of a $0.25\text{ mol dm}^{-3}$ $\text{FeCl}_3$ solution.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text:
The table shows numerical values of the stability constants for the following equilibrium where M can be one of the metal ions listed and L one of the ligands which replaces **one** $\text{H}_2\text{O}$ molecule.

$$[\text{M}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_6]^{n+}(\text{aq}) + \text{L}^-(\text{aq}) \rightleftharpoons [\text{M}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_5\text{L}]^{(n-1)+}(\text{aq}) + \text{H}_2\text{O}(\text{l})$$

| metal ion, M | ligand, L | stability constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$ |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| $\text{Fe}^{3+}$ | $\text{F}^-$ | $1.0 \times 10^6$ |
| $\text{Fe}^{3+}$ | $\text{Cl}^-$ | $2.5 \times 10^1$ |
| $\text{Fe}^{3+}$ | $\text{SCN}^-$ | $9.0 \times 10^2$ |
| $\text{Hg}^{2+}$ | $\text{Cl}^-$ | $5.0 \times 10^6$ |

parts.label: (c)(i)
parts.text: What is meant by the term *stability constant*, $K_{\text{stab}}$?

parts.label: (c)(ii)
parts.text:
Use the data in the table to predict the formula of the complex formed in the greatest amount when

- a solution containing equal concentrations of both $\text{F}^-$ and $\text{SCN}^-$ ions is added to $\text{Fe}^{3+}(\text{aq})$,

- a solution containing equal concentrations of both $\text{Fe}^{3+}$ and $\text{Hg}^{2+}$ ions is added to $\text{Cl}^-(\text{aq})$.

parts.label: (d)
parts.stem: Ethanedioate ions, ${}^-\text{O}_2\text{CCO}_2^-$, are bidentate ligands. The abbreviation $ed^{2-}$ can be used to represent ethanedioate ions.
parts.text:
The complex $[\text{Fe}(ed)_2\text{Cl}_2]^{3-}$ can be formed according to the equation shown.

$$[\text{Fe}(\text{H}_2\text{O})_4\text{Cl}_2]^+(\text{aq}) + 2ed^{2-}(\text{aq}) \rightleftharpoons [\text{Fe}(ed)_2\text{Cl}_2]^{3-}(\text{aq}) + 4\text{H}_2\text{O}(\text{l})$$

Write the expression for the equilibrium constant, $K_{\text{stab}}$, and state its units.

parts.label: (e)(i)
(e)(ii)
parts.text: Give the letters of two isomers of $[\text{Fe}(ed)_2\text{Cl}_2]^{3-}$ which are geometrical isomers of each other.

parts.label: (e)(iii)
parts.text: Give the letters of the two isomers of $[\text{Fe}(ed)_2\text{Cl}_2]^{3-}$ which show optical isomerism.

parts.label: (e)(iv)
parts.text: Give the letter of the isomer which has **no** dipole moment.
